exact_block_argument.parity_selection: For each fixed exceptional-prefix/e block, the C3 condition fixes exactly one parity class of x4. Therefore the retained count in that block is either N/2 or N/2+1, and the rejected count is the complementary value.

aggregate_exact_bounds.formula: both surviving and rejected counts lie in [(T-P)/2,(T+P)/2] before resolving the required x4 parity distribution block-by-block
